header.title: Population growth by component
tablenote: Population growth (sum of natural change and net movement); refers to growth between same reference time-point of preceding year and designated year.  The figures from 1961 to 1996 are compiled based on the "extended de facto" method and those from 1997 onwards are compiled based on the "resident population" method.  Figures may not add up to the total due to rounding.
header.source: Demographic Statistics Section (1), Census and Statistics Department (Enquiry telephone no. : 3863 2702  Enquiry e-mail : population@censtatd.gov.hk)
